EmailTemplate.description: Sent to a channel partner when its site visit request is not approved (Partner Portal Setting: Visit Rejected Email Template). [[Customer]], [[Visit Date]] and [[Visit Time]] are filled in by PartnerSiteVisitService; [[Reason]] stands for the approver's comment. Without a comment the part between <!--reason--> and <!--/reason--> is left out, and in the text version the line that holds [[Reason]].
EmailTemplate.name: Partner Portal Site Visit Rejected
EmailTemplate.subject: Your site visit request for [[Customer]] was not approved
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Visit__c.OwnerFullName},
Your site visit request for [[Customer]] was not approved by John Keells Properties.
Customer: [[Customer]] Project: {!Visit__c.Project__c} Requested date: [[Visit Date]] Requested time: [[Visit Time]]
Reason given by John Keells Properties: [[Reason]]
NEXT STEP If this lead is still open, you can request another site visit on the Partner Portal: Leads → Edit → Site Visit Scheduled.
Thanks, John Keells Properties
